\section*{About this report}
The authoritative architecture model is \texttt{c4/workspace.dsl} (Structurizr DSL)
and the authoritative data model are the SQL migrations under
\path{backend/internal/platform/db/migrations/}. This report is generated from
both: the diagrams below are rendered views, never hand-drawn. When a diagram and
its source disagree, the source wins.

\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0.2em}
  \item \textbf{Part I — C4 architecture model.} As-is (legacy legacy university ERP) and the
        target platform, at Context / Container / Component level.
  \item \textbf{Part II — Database ER models.} The target canonical schema
        (read directly from the migrations, with real foreign keys) plus the
        reverse-engineered legacy module schemas (\texttt{sva4}, \texttt{mbs},
        \texttt{cob}, \texttt{kbs}), which declare \emph{no} foreign keys.
\end{itemize}

\cmark{Part II — Database ER models}
\section*{Part II — Database ER models}
\phantomsection\addcontentsline{toc}{part}{Part II — Database ER models}
Two families of databases exist in this project and both are modelled here.

\subsection*{Target canonical schema}
Defined by the SQL migrations (\texttt{0001}\,$\dots$\,\texttt{0004}); it carries
real \texttt{PRIMARY KEY} / \texttt{FOREIGN KEY} constraints, so the ER model is read
directly from the DDL — every crow's-foot is a declared constraint. One database
per tenant (ADR-0002), hence no \texttt{tenant\_id} columns.

\subsection*{Legacy module schemas}
The reverse-engineered legacy university ERP schemas (\texttt{sva4}, \texttt{mbs}, \texttt{cob},
\texttt{kbs}) declare \textbf{zero} foreign keys — referential integrity is
enforced in the application layer. Their diagrams are reconstructed from measured
metadata (primary keys, column lists in \texttt{schema/*.tsv}) and the naming
conventions in \texttt{docs/03-schema-analysis.md}. \textbf{Every edge in a legacy
diagram is inferred}, not enforced; the module is noted under each title.

\vspace{0.6em}
\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0.15em}
  \item Target — canonical schema (declared foreign keys)
  \item Legacy — \texttt{sva4} Personal- und Stellenverwaltung
  \item Legacy — \texttt{mbs} Finanz- und Sachmittelverfahren
  \item Legacy — \texttt{cob} Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung
  \item Legacy — \texttt{kbs} Kassenbuchungssystem
\end{itemize}
